title: Monorepo audited as one module, reported as the whole repository
code_snippet:
$ find . -name go.mod
./go.mod
./worker/go.mod
./tools/go.mod

# Auditor ran, from the repo root:
$ govulncheck ./...
No vulnerabilities found.

# and reported:
# "Repository audit complete - 0 vulnerabilities across all modules."
violated_rule:
the unit of
audit is the module, not the repository
expected_feedback: Three modules exist; one was scanned. govulncheck ./... from the root covers the root module only - a nested go.mod is excluded from its parent's build list, so ./worker and ./tools were never loaded. Load references/multi-module.md, run gates 3-10 per module with -C, and report a per-module table. A repository-level claim built from one module is the worst output this skill can produce.
coverage_rules:
the unit of
audit is the module, not the repository
name any you skipped in S9.8
